::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 14th 1888  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/12
:::

Dear Mr Dean

Thank you most heartily for the kind thought of sending me this gratifying testimony to what the actions themselves can inspire

yours very truly
C M Yonge
